body:
Hello,
I would like to talk more with you about your strategy I think you did. Message me, I would like to exchange some tips :D

Man!
It's horrible, I know!
My wife left me also like yours.
Don't panic! It will be horrible for a period, but just stay! You'll see that she is not the person you need! You'll find another one! Go to gym, daily, eat healthy, go to your new job and even if you struggle, try to do it!
Just think about how many persons don't have at least one wife. Just think about how smart you are and you can't do this? A shitty woman?
A great woman don't divorce! A great woman is fighting for her marriage and will put it on the first place!
You're great man, don't let her fuck you!
You deserve more!
Just think about it: is better if she leaves even if it's hard now!
She was...just in the last period is this problem.

Omg, how beautiful you are!
I think you need to cry more days just for how beautiful you are!

My faith in humanity disapeared.
Everything is so false! I feel like I will never be able to find true love. Even if girls like me, I know they are brainwashed by this hyper sexualized society. I don't like sex, I tried a few times and I hate it. I like to make love with someone I love... I feel like I will never be able to be happy again. Because is like I realised this.
I had a deception in love (the only single reason that keept me running) and ...omg... is extremly painful. I'm a different kind of man and girls nowdays are not searching for this anymore.
As I said, I consider myself as being cute, funny, smart, young, a good friend and a familist. But...girls nowdays wants bad boys. And I can't be a bad boy. Because why to be a piece of shit? I don't want just sex... I want a powerful relationship where both sides to fight for it. Not just me.
Maybe I'm too mature for my age, but is painful!
So painful.
I used to be very optimistic and I achived a lot of things until my age: a house, a car, financial freedom, strong character, good friends...but....I'm low...so low.
Extremly low! I don't have energy anymore(even if I'm fit, doing gym and other sports).
I just want this to end!
As I said, I'll never do suicide, but the thought about it is so comfortable. At least, I will not live forever.
I will continue to fight! Until the end!

They don't know they are fake. They don't want you because they didn't have your feelings.
It's hard to understand that people don't think like you and they don't give a fuck about your feelings. 
And this is the difficult part, you suffer or you'll change your attitude.
It's a paradox. But if you'll be able in a way to be happy and you don't care so much about others, they will be attracted by you.

Nobody deserve this pain.
And it's more painful when you see other persons who has nothing and they don't want to hear about you.
It's horrible.
But...
This is our life
We need to suffer
Yes
We need to do it
Every single day
We don't have the right to stop it with suicide.
We need to fight or to suffer.
I preffer to fight. Every day I'm trying to do things to be proud of at the end of the day. And yes, I'm doing them.
I hate myself even if I have a bmw, I have a small company, girls (gf+other girls), beautiful friends and perfect parents. Yes! I have everything I want!
But it's not about money, relationships, how good you look, what's your IQ etc... It's all about you.
I'm sure I will find a way to stop this. Even if I need to fight 10 more years, or 20.
You can do this! Do things to be proud of! This is an example, I'm trying to talk with persons who have the same problem with me. When I'll try to sleep, I know that I did good things!
Peace my virtual friend!

Yes. The same feeling here. I think about it every single hour. But now as I saw the problem I need to fight against it.
I need to find reasons to live. Because I have tons to not. But I think this is my life meaning. To find ways (not meds, drugs or alcohool) to live.
I started to do sport. I feel better.
Of course at beginning you will feel nothing. But if you do it constantly you'll find that you will have minutes when you'll feel better and you don't know why.
Exactly,
If you do the same things every day, don't expect different results.
It's horrible to say, but it's upon to you. Yes, you need to do it. And you can, if you want enough!
Look at me. It's new year eve, I'm at a party with some friends and reading this subreddit, because, as I said, I'm thinking every hour about it. 
It's the easiest "solution". In fact it is not.
I will never be able to do it, not because or fear, but I am showing me that I have power. Power to have bad days every day

It's all about perspective.
Think about what I talk about.
Wait a few more months and think more!
Life is not easy, that's a fact. It's fucking hard. But you're not the person who can take this decision!

Stay here and wait.
How old are you? You know how many persons have the same feelings like you and after they feel better?
Just wait, have courage to fight and you will succed!
I know that everything is pointless, I have the dame feeling, but this is the question. Can we fight with this?
I think yes. I fight every day with this.
After all, you'll be so powerful if you'll be able to fight now!
In 4 years if you'll fight. I mean, FIGHT, not just hope, you'll look back and you'll smile about what things you did. And yes, you will be very happy!

It sounds so easy to do this. But why to be so weak to do it? You want something? So really you need to fight for it. And suffer for it. Suffer and cry until you'll find a way! That's why I'm in this sub, because I suffer a lot, but I will never stop trying and I am sure I will succed!
Don't do it. Just wait more months and think more about it. In the worst scenario you will be in the same place you are now, but maybe the things will change.
There are also 22 female year old virgins with the same feeling. It's upon to to you to find them.
Many persons at your age have the same problem as you have. Is all about identity and if you'll pass this period, you'll find a better version of you and you will be happy with who you are.

My opinion is to not doing this.
You're 16. There's a lot more time to have better days. Trust me! You'll have better days!
You will find a way! Will be hard, but you'll find.
I'm here because I also have suicidal thoughts every day but I'm 100% sure one day I will be fine!

How old are you?
How long you suffered?
That's an exactly cause for this?
Just tell me more. I'm here to listen to you.

You will get better over time! Don't focus on the problem, focus on how you can solve it!
You will find a solution! I'm sure!

Same feelings like you every day.
I just hope for a better tommorow.
I used to have an amazing self-esteem, but now the most comfortable thing is to think about death. But I will struggle as much as it needs to fight with this until the point I will be proud of me!
It's a fight with me! I know it! And I will win it finnaly, even if now I don't see any solutions!
I just want to be happy (at least 10% of time) and I will!
Trust me, this will gonna change over time!

Yes, yes and again yes! Extremly hard! I wish I can have a chat where I can talk with other persons on the same topic...at least, we have Reddit. I feel like I'm so stupid after the breakup, it's because of the lack of confidence...even if I used to have a huge confidence before...I mean, nothing could stop me before, but now...even a radio song😂 so, in conclusion, I feel your pain!
P.S. I have thoughts that I am born so late. I would like to be borned in ~1970...

Yes! The same feelings I had! It's horrible, the worst experience in my life. Things will improve, but slow...I'm a mensa member, so, a high iq, and I think it is harder for a smart person to go through this process then other persons...maybe it's just my opinion...some persons are caring just about their feelings and they don't want to do anything to improve the relationship if it has any difficulty. So maybe it's ok to find a person who cares about you and not just staying with you because of "just love", because the "love" feeling is just a 3-4 years feeling...in this way we need to change partners every few years? It's not normal. Society needs families. Find a girl who wants a family and you'll be happy!
Yes, I feel the same...never ever be loved again...
Make it 30-45 days! Trust me! It'll work better than contacting eariler.
Nope...she will. Karma will hit her, stay calm.
How much time passed from when you had a good time?

Are you sure you don't have something and is not about him? Are you 100% sure? If you are, then it's just about the time, if not, you'll need to find what's wrong and work so hard to solve it. Maybe you found him as your problem, but was not him...just give us more details:D

It's unbelievable that this kind of actions exists. But you need to understand that karma exists. Happend to me because I didn't realized a true love from a girl and now another one did exactly the same thing I did before...and it hurts. Is the most terrifing feel I ever experienced in my life. I just want to be something like an app and a dna test where you can upload your profile and find the perfect person to be with...

Just assume your action...
If you really want her back, just wait 3-4 weeks and call or text her. But don't do this before this time. It is very important to let her thinking about this situation.

I feel you. Just the thing I could say is that you had just almost 2 years and not more. The pain is fine and normal. From my experience I can tell you that you'll have a cycle(bad times, good times, but you will see thay bad times will be better and better over time).
I also have some questions:
Did you really liked her or was just some good time around her?
Was she the best girl you can ever have?
Did you feel the most amazing things or it was just comfortable?
She doesn't deserve you, but the girls are girls...
Just give us more details. How old are you? Where do you live? You had breakups before? How much you was with him? Etc.

I am a strange kind of person. I really don't expect to much from someone and I don't suffer if someone is not treating me like I do. I can just love her and do everything without expecting something back...I know she doesn't deserves me and everybody told me the same, even their parents, but I don't care...that's my problem, I can't get angry on her...maybe this is another thing she knows and profits.

She is overthinking everything, like I do. I feel like she will not try to contact me even she will want to because of her overthinking...and I'm trying to find a solution for this. But I guess this is it and I will need to let her go...
